Tuition fee/Students' Union fee
Tuition fee/Students' Union fee
As long as you are studying at the University of Vienna, you must pay the prescribed tuition/Students' Union fee each semester within the payment period. By making this payment, you finalise your admission in the first semester. In subsequent semesters, this payment confirms that you are continuing your studies.
Select the relevant question below. You will be redirected to a new page where you will find all the information you need.
©
Ian Ehm
How much do I have to pay?
Find out how much your Tuition/Students' Union fee is.
How does the payment process work?
This is how you pay your Tuition/Students' Union fee and continue your studies.
How do I apply for remission or reimbursement?
All infos on deadlines and grounds for remission or reimbursement.
Do I qualify for equal status?
In certain cases, the same tuition fee regulations apply to non-EU/EEA nationals as to EU/EEA nationals.
Are you studying at the VWU? Here's what you need to know!
If you are currently studying at the University Preparation Programme of the Vienna Universities (VWU), you pay two fees seperately:
your course fee at the VWU first and then
the Students' union fee at the University of Vienna.
